item.title: Gentoo Media - Notification of trade
item.description: Jonas Warrer Petersen Holding ApS, a company owned by Jonas Warrer, CEO and primary insider of Gentoo Media Inc., has today purchased 20,000 shares in Gentoo Media at a price of SEK 3.98 per share. After this transaction, Jonas Warrer holds 2,000,000 options and close associates of Jonas Warrer own 1,235,120 shares in Gentoo Media. For questions, please contact: jonas.warrer@g2m.com, +45 3078 8450 About Gentoo Media Gentoo Media is a leading iGaming affiliate connecting operators with high-value players through premium lead generation and compliance solutions.
